_about: Which Pokemon Journeys overworld sheet (assets/dungeon/characters, dev/builders/import_dungeon_sprites.py) is whose on the dungeon map. trainers: by battle sprite (Journeys' trchar### numbers follow its PBS trainertypes.txt); pokemon: species -> [sheet, column] (the Pokemon sheets: a column a Pokemon, a row a way it faces); figures: a route button by "AREA:TEXT" -> {sheet} or {item} or {pokemon}; townsperson: anyone else. A trainer or Pokemon left out keeps its battle sprite or party icon. players: your trainer by character (girls: who walks as the girl's sheet; anyone else as the boy's).

player_extra._about: Your trainer's own extra overworld sheets, by character (4 x 4 like a walking sheet, rows down/left/right/up; or {file, cols, rows}: a strip of frames). bike: riding (columns: still, pedal, still, pedal); surf: sitting on your Pokemon; fish: casting (4 frames a way); field: using a field move (Strength, Rock Smash); dive: swimming underwater; run: running. Anyone without one keeps the walking sheet (and the drawn Bicycle). vsseeker / vsseeker_bike: holding up the VS Seeker (FireRed's own frames for Red and Leaf, 11-19; "scale": 2, FireRed's pixels beside Journeys' walking sheets). Not used yet: capback (the cap turned backwards).

region_followers._about: A region's own overworld sheets for its Pokemon (assets/dungeon/characters), by follower sheet name (species, species_form, form id), used before assets/dungeon/followers while you're in that region; anywhere else they're the fallback for a form the follower sheets lack (Jordan 11-23: a game-built region's own sheets first, followers as fallback; a form only one region drew follows you everywhere with that region's sheet). dungeon.region_sheet_paths.
